table.retrieve:
SELECT 	
	customicode=item.customicode,
	name=item.name, 
	currlistrow = 0,
	totalstock=0.0000,
	stock=0.0000, 
	itemtotalval=space(30),
	icode=purdetail.icode,
	batch=purdetail.batch,
	expiry=purdetail.expiry,
	gcode=purdetail.gcode, 
	packqty=purdetail.packqty+purdetail.looseqty,   
	looseqty=purdetail.looseqty,
	bonusqty=purdetail.bonusqty,
	packunits=purdetail.packunits,      
	purprice=purdetail.purprice,   
	code=purdetail.purinvcode,
	avgprice=purdetail.avgprice,
	PurRowID=purdetail.PurRowID,
	newavgprice=purdetail.newavgprice,
	currstock=purdetail.currstock,
	purutn =purdetail.purutn ,
	gstperc=purdetail.gstperc,
	unitsalestax=purdetail.unitsalestax,
	saleprice=purdetail.saleprice,
	rate=purdetail.rate,
	itemdescription=purdetail.itemdescription,
	discperc=purdetail.discperc

FROM 
	crs_purdetail purdetail, 
	item
WHERE
	( purdetail.clientinstanceid = :r_clientinstanceid ) AND
	( purdetail.purinvcode = :r_InvCode )   and
	( purdetail.icode = item.icode )

objects.name: d_detaildwtotal
objects.expression: sum( ( ( purprice  *  looseqty )  + ( purprice  *  packqty) ) *  ( 1- ( discperc  * .01  ) )   for all)

objects.name: compute_4
objects.expression: sum( round((purprice * discperc * 0.01) * (packqty + looseqty),2) for all)
